q: What is the Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA)?
a: The Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA) is the UAE federal regulator for securities and commodities markets. It licenses, supervises, and enforces regulations to protect investors and support fair, efficient, and transparent markets.

q: How can I verify a company’s SCA license or registration?
a: Use SCA’s public register of licensed companies. Enter the company name or license number to view status, licensed activities, and other details.

q: What does it mean to be an SCA-licensed Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP)?
a: An SCA-licensed VASP is authorized to provide virtual asset services, such as exchanges or custody, in line with UAE regulations. Licensing signals compliance with SCA’s prudential, conduct, and AML/CFT standards.

q: What is a finfluencer or financial recommendations provider under SCA?
a: A financial recommendations provider (finfluencer) is an individual or entity registered with SCA to publish investment recommendations or analysis to the public. They must adhere to SCA’s disclosure and conduct requirements.

q: How does SCA supervise companies and finfluencers?
a: SCA supervises through ongoing reporting, inspections, and market surveillance. It can issue directions, impose penalties, suspend activities, or revoke licenses where necessary.

q: What happens if a company or finfluencer violates regulations?
a: SCA may take enforcement action, which can include warnings, fines, suspension, or license revocation. Matters can also be referred to other competent authorities where applicable.

q: What protections does SCA offer to investors?
a: SCA sets disclosure, conduct, and prudential standards; monitors compliance; and provides channels for complaints and investor education to help protect retail and professional investors.

q: What are my rights as an investor under SCA regulation?
a: Investors have the right to fair dealing, clear information, and access to complaint mechanisms. Regulated firms must treat clients fairly and manage conflicts of interest.

q: How can I access the public register of licensed companies?
a: Visit SCA’s open-data licensed companies page and search by company name or code.

q: Can a finfluencer provide investment advice legally?
a: Yes—if registered or licensed with SCA as a financial recommendations provider and acting within the scope of approval, with required disclosures.

q: Which financial activities fall under the supervision of the SCA?
a: Please refer to the Rulebook, which covers all financial activities: SCA Chairman's Decision No. (13/Chairman) of 2021 on the Rulebook for Financial Activities and Status Regularization Mechanisms. https://beta.sca.ae/en/regulations/regulations-listing?id=206

q: Is the SCA responsible for insurance services?
a: The SCA is not responsible for insurance services; these fall under the UAE Central Bank.

q: Do financial advisory services fall under the SCA's jurisdiction?
a: Yes, financial advisory services fall under the SCA's jurisdiction. You can refer to the Rulebook SCA Chairman's Decision No. (13/Chairman) of 2021 on the Rulebook for Financial Activities and Status Regularization Mechanisms. https://beta.sca.ae/en/regulations/regulations-listing?id=206

q: What are the registration fees for a finfluencer?
a: The financial influencer is exempt from the registration fee and the annual registration renewal fee for a period of three (3) years from the effective date of the financial influencer's decision. After this period, the registration fee will be AED 5,000 and the annual renewal fee will be AED 2,500.

q: Where can I get the finfluencer registration form?
a: Please send your request to the licensing department via email: licensing@sca.ae

q: How can I verify the list of authorized finfluencer?
a: You can check it on the SCA website by accessing open data and then clicking on list of authorized Finfluencers. https://www.sca.gov.ae/en/open-data/list-of-authorized-finfluencers

q: As an Emirati, can I register for the SCA's exams? What are the fees?
a: The SCA provides a free of charge exam for the first time of each test for all UAE Nationals working the Brokerage Companies. The SCA provides a free of charge for the UAE Nationals non-working with the Brokerage Companies for the first time of each test. The SCA bears 50% of the exam fees for re-sitting for the exam for the first time.

q: When will the exam materials be sent?
a: After you receive confirmation from the cisi institute, the exam materials will be sent to you via email.

q: How can I claim unclaimed dividends before March 2015?
a: The SCA appointed First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) to handle the process of unclaimed dividends. Please check the following link for more details: https://www.sca.gov.ae/en/about-us/sca-projects/distribution-of-unclaimed-dividends-and-amounts-of-dormant-accounts-at-brokerage-firms/payment-of-unclaimed-dividends-dating-back-to-before-march-2015-to-shareholders-of-locally-listed

q: When can the professional licensing exam be rescheduled to another day?
a: Exam reschedule is allowed only one time and only when exam date is not within 7 days.

q: Are there any fees for submitting a complaint? If so, how much?
a: Yes, the fee is 500 AED.

q: What are the fees for the Investment Fund Management activity?
a: Yes, the fee is 3000 AED for application fees and 5000 for licensing fees.

q: What is the required capital to license a first-category activity, such as a trading broker?
a: The paid-up capital is not less than 30 million AED.

q: Is it possible to recover amounts seized by unlicensed companies?
a: The SCA is not responsible for the recovery of any amounts individuals may have lost as a result of dealing with entities it has not licensed. You can only report them through the following link: https://www.sca.gov.ae/en/services/reporting-capital-market-violations

q: Can I submit a complaint against an unlicensed company?
a: You can report unlicensed companies through the SCA's reporting system: https://www.sca.gov.ae/en/services/reporting-capital-market-violations

q: How long does it take to process a new financial activity license request?
a: It takes 45 days.

q: Can I get a link to the Corporate Governance Guide?
a: Chairman of Authority's Board of Directors' Decision no. (3/Chairman) of 2020 concerning Approval of Joint Stock Companies Governance Guide. https://beta.sca.ae/en/regulations/regulations-listing?id=198

q: How can I book the Professional Licensing Program exam?
a: The booking and payment can be done through the superuser in your company via the portal.

q: What are the fees required for the equivalency of professional certificates and exams?
a: The fee is 1500 AED.

q: Can I get a link to the SCA rulebook?
a: The Chairman of the Authority's Board of Directors' Decision No. (13/Chairman) of 2021 on the Regulations Manual of the Financial Activities and Status Regularization Mechanisms Rule Book. https://beta.sca.ae/en/regulations/regulations-listing?id=206
